unit: 15 issue groups; distinct from 32 attack paths and 31 PR17 enforcement rows
boolean_semantics: blocks_ingress_activation means ordinary/non-test ingress. Narrow synthetic test ingress can be authorized to obtain B evidence only after A gates, explicit scope and safe hold/recovery; this file authorizes nothing.

issues.description: Control who can alter or reuse V6 authority
issues.bucket_reason: Waiting for protected resources to exist would expose role-use and policy-attachment windows. This is one upstream authority property, not separate blockers for each API operation.
issues.closure_or_test: Approve and independently evaluate a complete principal/action/resource/context graph, then separately authorize containment establishment and read-back before creating usable V6 roles/functions/data paths. Cover legacy management, PassRole/alternate Lambda, Gateway mutation, role/boundary replacement, stack operators and rollback windows. Generated API identifiers require an inert-create/inspect/fence hold before routes or traffic. No proposed control is installed in PR18.
issues.freshness_requirement: Refresh caller, identity grants, boundaries, trust, relevant organization/session constraints and simulations immediately before authority/bootstrap authorization; invalidate on any authority change.
unresolved_assumptions: Effective future policies are untested.
Known legacy list is not a complete guarantee against future principals.
API identifiers may not be known before creation; exact pre-use fencing sequence must be reviewed.
No present legacy UpdateStack grant is established.

issues.description: Establish bounded, usable non-root bootstrap/deployment/recovery authority
issues.bucket_reason: Creating resources first and discovering nobody can contain or repair a failure is too late. A policy proposal is not an authenticated operator or usable recovery path.
issues.closure_or_test: Name independently approved non-root trust/assurance and session limits; render exact normal maximum permissions and PassRole/stack relationships; separately approve temporary bootstrap/publishing/emergency powers, removal/expiry and a fallback for failed-create/retained resources. Confirm the actor can assume the required role and review effective grants before first candidate creation. Initial authority-establishment writes themselves require a separate explicit human-approved operation; this review does not authorize them.
issues.freshness_requirement: Recheck actual operator/session/role trust and effective grants immediately before each phase; emergency rights require a new approval and post-use removal evidence.
unresolved_assumptions: No approved recovery actor/role exists in inherited inventory.
Current normal proposal lacks CreateStack, bootstrap IAM/policy repair and publisher AssumeRole.
ContinueUpdateRollback is not a generic remedy for every failed-create state.

issues.description: Freeze an exact phased release and authenticated evidence/approval procedure
issues.bucket_reason: A generic PASS or manifest hash cannot safely authorize unspecified parameters, mutable exports, actors or later phases. The procedure and bounded failure plan must exist before the first write; future observations need not already exist.
issues.closure_or_test: Bind account/region, both template hashes, source/artifact/binding hashes, stack names/roles/parameters/exports, selected S3 version, tests and exact next allowed mutation set to independent review and explicit DevF consent. Define authenticated evidence acquisition, freshness/drift checks, cost/time/stop limits, lifecycle contingencies and expiry of approval. Formally resolve known validator findings without pretending lint passed. Approve provider/profile and binding before token-capable ingress, not before empty bootstrap. The current template does not itself implement all phase holds.
issues.freshness_requirement: Refresh evidence and human approval immediately before its named phase; invalidate on changed bytes, parameters, identities, policies or execution context. CI evidence remains exact-commit only.
unresolved_assumptions: No trusted evidence-verifier or executor exists; current gate always denies deployment.
Runtime template also creates deployment/stage; a future reviewed inert-start/activation mechanism is required for separate holds.
Unapproved provider/configuration cannot be replaced with invented placeholder live values.

issues.description: Real provider profile, JWT enforcement and claim projection
issues.bucket_reason: Signature rejection and Gateway projection require actual provider/Gateway execution. Demanding them before an empty API exists is circular. Provider selection/approval is an A3 pre-ingress requirement, not execution proof.
issues.closure_or_test: After A gates and explicit test authorization, use only approved synthetic sandbox identities to test RSA/JWKS rotation, aud AND client_id, sub, token_use=access, exact scope/scopes shapes, exp/iat/optional nbf, extra claims and binding mismatch. Hold general ingress until positive/negative evidence is reviewed.
issues.freshness_requirement: Rerun on provider/client/flow/key, authorizer, adapter or binding changes; inspect configuration immediately before enabling test ingress.
unresolved_assumptions: No provider approved; absence of sampled Cognito pools does not exclude external providers.
All-string claims and scalar aud are provider-selectable constraints, not universal OIDC guarantees.

issues.description: Effective invocation, data/resource fences and AWS service context
issues.bucket_reason: Actual qualified-policy/source context and negative enforcement require real isolated resources. Safe tests depend on A1 independent authority containment and A2 recovery, not on prior proof of those exact future resource policies.
issues.closure_or_test: Under separate test authority, verify metadata and negative unqualified/version/alias/URL invocations, exact Gateway sources, legacy table/index denials, role-use restrictions and allowed service path on synthetic data. Do not treat IAM simulation as execution. No test principal receives standing broad access merely to conduct the test.
issues.freshness_requirement: Repeat affected negatives after any role/trust/resource policy/boundary/route or principal inventory change; record exact qualifier and session.
unresolved_assumptions: Policy attachment/effective IAM/SCP/session behavior unobserved.
Direct same-account access is not disproved by a narrow runtime role.

issues.description: Initial provider lifecycle and selected artifact retrieval
issues.bucket_reason: Successful resource creation and service retrieval of the selected S3 version cannot be observed without a bounded create attempt. A1/A2 must already cover partial creation and failure.
issues.closure_or_test: During controlled creation, inspect ordering, resulting policies, service-role associations and exact object version/hash retrieval. If denied, preserve events, keep ingress closed and analyze actual principal/context before widening any permission.
issues.freshness_requirement: Evidence applies only to exact template/parameters/role/bucket/version and current regional provider; repeat on relevant changes.
unresolved_assumptions: S3 delivery service principal/context unknown.
Static schema validation is not a live provider trace.

issues.bucket_reason: Provider delete calls and recovery transitions need deployed resources. Requiring a successful delete before first create is circular. A2 still requires usable bounded contingency authority before attempting creation.
issues.closure_or_test: Authorize a synthetic lifecycle drill with stop/quarantine plan, inspect stack events and actual exercising principal/request where available, test retained resource access and temporary-right removal. Carry PR16 DescribeStacks target/principal/request ambiguity unchanged; no speculative grant.
issues.freshness_requirement: Retest relevant lifecycle on provider version, template, service/recovery role or retention changes; refresh authority immediately before drill.
unresolved_assumptions: Declared delete-handler permission is not observed invocation.
Actual delete target/principal and failure-state repair remain unknown.
Passing a drill is required before expanding sandbox use beyond the bounded experiment, even though not before first creation.

issues.description: Configuration snapshots and binding revocation transitions
issues.bucket_reason: Static evidence already identifies fixed Version/Deployment properties. It is not an initial-create defect. Transition behavior must be corrected/tested before relying on an update or revocation, with ingress stopped if needed.
issues.closure_or_test: Separate remediation should bind published Lambda/API snapshots to all material configuration changes. Test alias/version/route rollout, warm-host bindings and a bounded stop method using synthetic identities before ordinary ingress or any claimed revocation guarantee.
issues.freshness_requirement: Rerun on snapshot logic, route/configuration, registry or alias rollout changes.
unresolved_assumptions: DependsOn is ordering, not snapshot republishing.
Packaged registry changes alter artifact hash but do not provide instantaneous distributed revocation.

issues.description: Tiny sandbox operation, concurrency and cost stop signals
issues.bucket_reason: Actual latency, throttling, sanitized telemetry and spend depend on running the sandbox. A3 must already approve bounded volume/duration/stop rules; sustained production load proof is unnecessary for first creation.
issues.closure_or_test: At minimal authorized volume, verify shared concurrency, throttling/503/rejection/not-found signals, logs contain no payload/claims and costs remain within human-approved limits. Stop on unexpected exposure, logging or spend; do not promise zero cost.
issues.freshness_requirement: Refresh regional quotas/pricing and human spend limit before experiment; observe actual signals during it.
unresolved_assumptions: Quota/cost observations inherited from earlier preflight are not a present allowance.
No load or billing test occurred in PR18.

issues.description: Production capacity, durability, backup and service objectives
issues.bucket_reason: A finite synthetic human sandbox can stop and retain evidence; production requires concurrency/durability/load/restore/SLO evidence beyond it.
issues.closure_or_test: Before production, define data retention/backup/restore, capacity and failure budgets, run meaningful load/concurrency/durability/restore tests and approve recurring cost/operational ownership.
issues.freshness_requirement: Revalidate against approved production topology, data and workload.
unresolved_assumptions: No production workload or SLO approved.

issues.description: Production revocation, key/identity lifecycle and incident governance
issues.bucket_reason: Sandbox can use a small synthetic identity set and a tested stop control; production needs defined distributed revocation/session/key compromise responses.
issues.closure_or_test: Define revocation delay/SLO, JWKS rotation overlap and compromise response, subject/client lifecycle, auditing and incident ownership; verify beyond isolated synthetic cases.
issues.freshness_requirement: Refresh on identity/security policy or provider changes and according to approved operational schedule.
unresolved_assumptions: No instantaneous revocation property is established.

issues.description: Production caller/data migration and administrative separation
issues.bucket_reason: Legacy migration is explicitly outside the isolated sandbox; production needs separately approved callers, data classification and rollback/account governance.
issues.closure_or_test: Approve migration/data governance and stronger account/administrative separation as justified; preserve legacy evidence and obtain new production authorization.
issues.freshness_requirement: Bind to separate production release and current caller/data inventory.
unresolved_assumptions: No production migration authorized; second account not assumed.

issues.description: Root/admin and deliberately trusted release authority limits
issues.bucket_reason: Same-account policy cannot constrain an administrator able to replace it. Accepting that declared threat-model limit is distinct from accepting ordinary legacy bypasses.
issues.closure_or_test: Keep explicit human governance and non-root normal workflow; assess stronger separation for production. Never treat this limit as permission for root writes or standing recovery admin.
issues.freshness_requirement: Refresh trust assumptions if account governance or privileged operators change.
unresolved_assumptions: Account-level administrator override remains possible.

issues.bucket_reason: PR15 sampled live ResourceArn schemas and supported policy APIs retire those as independently proven candidate syntax/action defects; pinned1.40.2 diagnostics remain real failed checks. This is not proof of deployment success.
issues.closure_or_test: Preserve failing pinned result and PR15 newer-validator comparison; future reviewed tool/disposition decision belongs to A3. No suppression, internal schema patch or dependency upgrade in PR18.
issues.freshness_requirement: Refresh official registry/schema/catalog when selecting actual deployment region/provider and validating final release.
unresolved_assumptions: Public HTML contradiction remains visible.
PR16 handler authority ambiguity is B4, not resolved by validator modernization.

issues.description: Evidence lineage and controls that survive the isolated attack
issues.bucket_reason: Finite model controls and independent execution remain useful but limited. Correcting a stale CI citation does not establish an exploit or erase actual final-head execution.
issues.closure_or_test: Preserve distinct evidence classes; actual workflow head_sha prevails. PR16 final run36252726480 exists; run36252559383 is historical. Retain strict parser/binding, selected S3 version and maximum-boundary controls while testing AWS effects in B.
issues.freshness_requirement: Always reconcile exact final SHA/run/hashes; outputs transfer only when every relevant input and environment is identical and explicitly identified.
unresolved_assumptions: Tests may omit attacks; hashes do not authenticate author or human consent.

phases.name: Authorization/evidence preflight
phases.prerequisites: Approved account/region and exact phase scope; A1/A2 design; authentic DevF review
phases.principal: Independent reviewer + proposed non-root operator, read-only
phases.expected_evidence: Current identity/policy/trust graph, exact source/templates/parameters, risk and stop plan
phases.success: Named next phase authorized for exact coordinate only

phases.name: Establish authority and minimum inert bootstrap
phases.prerequisites: A1/A2 closure for resources being created; A3 exact bootstrap operation; independent approved authority exists
phases.principal: Separately approved non-root bootstrap operator; no root normal workflow
phases.mutation_category: Future separately authorized narrow IAM/fence establishment and bootstrap CF creation only
phases.expected_evidence: Effective grants/trust/boundaries, API ID, bucket/versioning/policy and exported identities
phases.success: Only reviewed inert resources exist; no usable uncontained role/data/traffic path
phases.failure: Unexpected resource, overbroad authority or partial failure: STOP
phases.rollback: Preapproved quarantine/retention/repair path; do not automatically delete evidence

phases.name: Inspect bootstrap and refresh exact-ID fences
phases.prerequisites: Phase1 complete or safely stopped; inert API; no sensitive artifacts or routes
phases.principal: Read-only reviewer; separately approved fence operator if a write is required
phases.mutation_category: Read-back; any exact-ID policy change needs explicit separate approval
phases.expected_evidence: Actual API/bucket/role/export identities and intended-vs-actual diff; no unwanted users of new roles
phases.success: A1 covers actual identities and independent creator/rollback windows
phases.failure: Unknown mutator/reuser or drift: keep ingress closed
phases.rollback: Keep inert; approved containment repair or retention
phases.fresh_human_authorization: Required for writes, not read-only inspection

phases.name: Publish immutable sandbox artifact
phases.prerequisites: Approved source/build/version intent; private fenced bucket and narrowly usable publisher
phases.principal: Approved actor assuming publisher role for this artifact only
phases.mutation_category: Future S3 new object version, no overwrite/delete of selected evidence
phases.expected_evidence: Bucket/key/version + independently verified artifact hash and publisher session
phases.success: Selected immutable version bound to release record
phases.rollback: Retain unused version; do not select it

phases.name: Create bounded runtime with ingress held
phases.prerequisites: A1/A2 effective containment; approved regional schema/tool disposition; exact provider parameters if template requires them; reviewed enforceable hold
phases.principal: Approved stack operator passing exact CloudFormation deployment role
phases.mutation_category: Future isolated runtime CF create only
phases.expected_evidence: Actual roles/boundaries, function/version/alias/table/policies and service retrieval; stack events
phases.success: Runtime correct and ingress held; no legacy mutation
phases.failure: Unexpected grants, failed create or missing protection: STOP
phases.rollback: Preapproved quarantine/failed-create retention/repair, not assumed ContinueUpdateRollback
phases.fresh_human_authorization: Required; current template combines stage/runtime and needs reviewed phase-hold treatment first

phases.name: Approve provider/profile and exact server binding
phases.prerequisites: Provider capability/flow and administrator approved; synthetic identities only; runtime remains held
phases.mutation_category: Future explicit IdP/config/binding operations only, none authorized here
phases.expected_evidence: Issuer/audience/client/scopes, approved subjects/tenant mapping, registry version/hash and actual published config
phases.success: Approved values bind the immutable release; no invented live values
phases.failure: Shape mismatch or unsafe update snapshots: remain held
phases.rollback: Keep held; return to reviewed config/release
phases.fresh_human_authorization: Required; move this phase before4 if current template needs real provider values

phases.name: Enable only controlled synthetic test ingress
phases.prerequisites: Configuration read-back; approved test plan; containment and recovery still current; B3 successful
phases.mutation_category: Future bounded activation under explicit test authority
phases.success: Only intended test scope active for approved interval
phases.failure: Drift/exposure: immediately use approved stop control
phases.rollback: Close test ingress using reviewed bounded control
phases.fresh_human_authorization: Required; testing permission is not ordinary ingress permission

phases.name: Run positive/negative sandbox tests
phases.prerequisites: Explicit invocation/synthetic data/test-principal authority; B1/B2/B5 test definitions
phases.principal: Approved test identities and constrained negative-test actor
phases.mutation_category: Future tightly scoped test invocations/synthetic items, prohibited in PR18
phases.expected_evidence: Real JWT/projection/source context/qualified-policy/role-use results, sanitized signals and hashes
phases.success: Expected allows/denies and no unexpected mutation/exposure
phases.failure: Any unsafe Allow, wrong claims/binding or leak: stop and retain evidence
phases.rollback: Close ingress; isolate synthetic state; independent remediation decision
phases.fresh_human_authorization: Required; no real credential/payload capture in evidence

phases.name: Exercise rollback/recovery and remove elevation
phases.prerequisites: Separate approved destructive/lifecycle scope and retained-resource plan; bounded repair authority
phases.principal: Approved recovery operator; emergency elevation only if independently authorized
phases.mutation_category: Future sandbox lifecycle/rollback/repair actions, none now
phases.expected_evidence: Actual handler/principal/context where observable, retained access, recovery and removal/expiry record
phases.success: Known stop/recovery path works and temporary authority removed
phases.failure: Unknown failed state: quarantine, stop and request exact repair authority
phases.rollback: Use only preapproved contingency; no improvised wildcard grants

phases.name: Authorize only the next named state
phases.prerequisites: B results reviewed; no unresolved safety failure; exact source/config still valid
phases.mutation_category: None from this record; any next use/phase requires separate scope
phases.expected_evidence: Signed/authenticated decision and evidence references, current hashes and authority
phases.success: Bounded next state explicitly approved or remains blocked
phases.next_gate: Further sandbox or separate production program
phases.fresh_human_authorization: Always required; never inferred from green CI
